transcript: Mia's school science fair was today and she was so nervous in the car on the way there, barely said a word. But she got up and explained her volcano project to the judges like a total pro, I was kind of blown away honestly. She didn't place but she didn't even care, she was just proud she did it.

beats.place_detail: in the car on the drive to the school science fair
beats.event: Mia was very nervous and quiet in the car on the way to her school science fair

beats.place_detail: a school gymnasium set up for a science fair
beats.event: Mia explained her volcano project to the judges confidently and didn't place but was proud anyway
beats.quote: she was just proud she did it
